answer: The yarrow schedule is applied in walnut and ocean makes public each instalment. An hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split which means 58% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3772 identities would post 1703 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
